name: auto-approve
description: Answers permission prompts for you: regex layers allow routine tool calls and always ask on pushes to protected branches, and haiku judges the rest against your plain-text rules. Offers a rule after you approve the same kind of call twice, and logs every decision so /auto-approve learn can suggest more

learn.title: Rule offers
learn.description: Where the mod offers a rule after you approved the same kind of call twice in a session: a band above the prompt, a pane that takes the keys, the question dialog, or never
